description: This Java class 'MidiPortConnector' facilitates connecting MIDI ports between two remote MIDI devices using Android's MIDI API. It provides methods to open devices, establish connections between their ports, and handle resource cleanup.

classes.name: MidiPortConnector
classes.description: A utility class for establishing and managing MIDI port connections between two remote MIDI devices.

classes.name: MidiPortConnector.OnPortsConnectedListener
classes.description: Interface for callback notification when MIDI ports are connected or connection fails.

methods.name: MidiPortConnector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connector with a MidiManager instance.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the active MIDI connection and associated devices, releasing resources.

methods.name: safeClose
methods.description: Attempts to close resources safely, catching and logging IOExceptions.

methods.name: connectToDevicePort (overloads)
methods.description: Establishes connections between two MIDI devices' ports, handling asynchronous device opening and port connection.
